notes.lakeside: OSM has Lakeside as 'Lakeside East' and 'Lakeside West' (way/561612677, way/561562513) either side of Lakeside Dining; pinned to Lakeside East. UA Facilities lists Lakeside Residential East and West/North at 150-152 McCorvey Dr (https://uafacilities.ua.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2026-Building-Representatives-List-Feb.pdf).
notes.presidential-village-1: OSM relation/8024836 'Presidential Village I' (676 Abercrombie Ln).
notes.presidential-village-2: OSM relation/8024837 'Presidential Village II' (622 Abercrombie Ln).
notes.ridgecrest-east-and-west: OSM has 'Ridgecrest East' (way/616039720) and 'Ridgecrest West' (way/616039716), about 140 m apart; pinned to Ridgecrest East.
notes.ridgecrest-south: Not in OSM by name. UA Facilities lists 'Ridgecrest Residential Community East, South, & West' at 900 2nd Street (https://uafacilities.ua.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2026-Building-Representatives-List-Feb.pdf); pinned at that address as Nominatim geocodes it (on 2nd St, way/516928266), beside Ridgecrest East.
notes.riverside: OSM has Riverside as 'Riverside East', 'North' and 'West' around Riverside Commons (172-178 Hackberry Ln); pinned to Riverside North, way/613976447.
notes.highlands: OSM 'Highlands at Hackberry' (145 Old Hackberry Ln), several buildings; pinned to way/608691246, mid-complex.
notes.parham-east: UA Facilities lists 'Martha Parham Hall East' at 922 6th Ave (https://uafacilities.ua.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2026-Building-Representatives-List-Feb.pdf); OSM relation/8546719 'Martha Parham Hall' (both wings).
notes.parham-west: UA Facilities lists 'Martha Parham Hall West' at 922 6th Ave (https://uafacilities.ua.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2026-Building-Representatives-List-Feb.pdf); OSM relation/8546719 'Martha Parham Hall' (both wings).
notes.bryce-lawn: Not in OSM yet. UA Housing gives 500 Bryce Lawn Dr (housing.sl.ua.edu/halls/bryce-lawn); pinned where Nominatim geocodes that address (interpolated along Bryce Lawn Dr, way/8866936).

detours.why: Residence-hall wings and their courtyards fill the straight line with no mapped path through, so walks leave by the hall's own paths and go round by the road.
